caption: The drawing depicts a tall grandfather clock with a wooden case. The clock is composed of three main sections: a square base with bracket feet, a tall rectangular midsection featuring a decorative wood grain panel, and an upper section housing the clock face, which is framed by an arched pediment. The wood is rendered in different shades of brown, highlighting the grain and panel detailing. The clock face itself is circular with Roman numerals, black clock hands, and a metallic gold background that includes detailed decoration, including corner spandrels and a smaller, circular inset above the main dial. The entire clock is drawn within a thin, single-line rectangular border.
title: Grandfather Clock
